correctness.rationale: Exact tangent linearization gives n(m-1)m^(n-1) for char not dividing m and n*m^n for p|m. Smooth family of x_i times units has matching dimension in the first case; in the latter, reduced geometric automorphisms lie in n coordinate hyperplanes cutting dimension at least n below the tangent. Translation by alpha_(p^e)^n is a closed subgroup for e=v_p(m), and the p-power finite-field count follows from Frobenius and Nakayama. Independent verify.py recomputed three complete small counts and 60 tangent instances. Purely finite counts are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Provides a motivated, sharp iff arithmetic criterion for scheme smoothness of an infinite natural family of multivariable finite complete intersections; makes the hidden infinitesimal translations explicit and calculates a uniform tangent dimension. Distinguishes full group schemes from reduced automorphism groups, addresses the characteristic constraint in recent monomial algebra automorphism theory, and identifies the exact scheme-theoretic boundary for all exponents, not a small numerical specialization.
